topic: Data API updates for frame and time data
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main technical tasks. First, the `data-api` needs modification to ensure that all frame IDs are reported in `viewedImpressionsByFrames`, even if the corresponding `viewedImpressions` count is zero. The structure must include entries for frames with zero impressions.

Second, there was a discussion regarding date formats in data exports (specifically for RZK). Initial confusion arose over whether the dates were YYYY-mm-dd HH:mm:ss or Unix timestamps. It was determined that the standard format is DateTime, but when exported to Parquet, the time might be incorrectly interpreted as milliseconds count. A link to ClickHouse documentation on data formats was provided for reference.
decisions: The `data-api` will be updated to include all frame IDs in `viewedImpressionsByFrames`, regardless of zero impressions.
The date format issue requires conversion advice, noting that the standard is DateTime but Parquet export may treat it as a millisecond count.
action_items: [me] deployed the updated frames logic to production.
[p1] will inform the relevant parties about the data API changes and date format guidance.
